claim_boundary: This is an ordinary characteristic-zero zero-intersection theorem for factor-span excess through m-1. It does not prove an exact Chow rank, optimize every finite-n numerical bound, improve border rank or establish literature novelty.

theorem.closed_band: For m>=3, q>=2 and q*n<=m^2+m-1, every q-term Chow block has zero intersection with D_m(perm_n).
theorem.zero_block: zeta_pol(n,m)=floor((m^2+m-1)/n), whenever the displayed integer is at least two.
